Circle.reason: Circle Line: Severe delays due to an earlier trespasser on the track at Earl's Court. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses via reasonable routes.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Uxbridge due to train cancellations.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Thursday 23 July, the 2159 train from Stratford to Richmond will terminate at Camden Road at 2219 and the 2318 train from Richmond to Willesden Junction will not run.

Weaver.reason: WEAVER LINE: Monday 20, Tuesday 21, Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 July, after 2245 each evening, no service between Hackney Downs and Enfield Town / Cheshunt. Last through trains operate at 2213 from Liverpool Street to Cheshunt, 2250 from Enfield Town to Liverpool Street, 2258 from Liverpool Street to Enfield Town and 2259 from Cheshunt to Liverpool Street. Use Clapton for Rectory Road and Stoke Newington, and local London Buses services for Stamford Hill. Replacement buses operate. The limited number of southbound GREATER ANGLIA and STANSTED EXPRESS trains after midnight which usually call at Seven Sisters are diverted via Tottenham Hale instead
